test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If a - b = 8 and ab = 9, then the value of a + b is ________.
solution:
Given:

a - b = 8 and ab = 9

Concept used:

(a - b)2 = (a + b)2 - 4ab

Calculation:

(a - b) = 8

⇒ (a - b)² = 8²

⇒ (a + b)² - 4ab = 64

⇒ (a + b)2 = 64 + 4 × 9

⇒ (a + b)2 = 100

⇒ (a + b) = ±10

**∴ The value of (a + b) is ±10.**
